Title: Information on: What is treason?...
Treason is a criminal offense that involves acting against one's nation or state, especially by attempting to overthrow the government or aid a foreign power. It is considered a serious violation of loyalty and can result in severe penalties, including imprisonment and even death. The specific definition and consequences of treason may vary depending on the jurisdiction.
